name: @alpiplan/mobile-shell
description: Capacitor native shell around the Alpiplan Nuxt app

scripts.cap:sync: cap sync && node scripts/patch-ios-info-plist.mjs && node scripts/patch-ios-push.mjs && node scripts/apply-ios-branding.mjs && node scripts/apply-android-identity.mjs && node scripts/apply-android-branding.mjs && node scripts/patch-android-push.mjs && node scripts/patch-android-release-signing.mjs
scripts.cap:add:android: cap add android && node scripts/apply-android-identity.mjs && node scripts/apply-android-branding.mjs && node scripts/patch-android-release-signing.mjs
scripts.cap:add:ios: cap add ios && node scripts/patch-ios-info-plist.mjs && node scripts/patch-ios-push.mjs && node scripts/apply-ios-branding.mjs
scripts.android:bundle-release: node scripts/apply-android-identity.mjs && node scripts/patch-android-release-signing.mjs && node scripts/check-android-release.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew clean bundleRelease
